8:9.text: when you sought help of your Lord and He answered you
: "I will help you with a thousand of the angels each behind the other

8:10.text: Allâh made it only as glad tidings, and that your hearts be at rest therewith. And there is no victory except from Allâh. Verily, Allâh is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

8:11.text: when He covered you with a slumber as a security from Him, and He caused water
to descend on you from the sky, to clean you thereby and to remove from you the Rijz
, and to strengthen your hearts, and make your feet firm thereby.

8:12.text: when your Lord revealed to the angels, "Verily, I am with you, so keep firm those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who have disbelieved, so strike them over the necks, and smite over all their fingers and toes."

8:13.text: This is because they defied and disobeyed Allâh and His Messenger. And whoever defies and disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then verily, Allâh is Severe in punishment.

8:14.text: , so taste it; and surely for the disbelievers is the torment of the Fire.

8:15.text: O you who believe! When you meet those who disbelieve, in a battle-field, never turn your backs to them.

8:16.text: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day - unless it be a stratagem of war, or to retreat to a troop
, - he indeed has drawn upon himself wrath from Allâh. And his abode is Hell, and worst indeed is that destination!
